_doc: #1445 THE GitHub connect is ONE implementation: libs:git-ui GitConnect / GitConnectRules (libs:git-sync's GitEngine + GitCredentialStore, libs:git-repos' Auto Commit message). Cloud Drive, Cloud Me and Cloud Account all call it. test-git-connect-one.sh fails when a file outside the owner libs builds a GitHub HTTPS credential (GitAuth.Https), clones with the engine (GitEngine.clone), names the x-access-token user or hands JGit a credentials provider; `legacy` (empty, it may only shrink) lists files not yet moved. Cloud Me, Cloud Account and libs:account-ui may not even import JGit. libs:account's GitSshVault (an in-memory SSH key read of the vault repo, no token, no checkout) is a different feature and is not a GitHub connect.
